title: Conformance results, version 1
description: One results.json per component and run. The runner writes it after a suite test plan finished; the gate, the HTML report, CI and the TestNG bridge in the testrigs read it. The runner computes each module's verdict once; readers map the verdict and never re-classify. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express (summary counts, gate consistency, verdict against suite result) are checked by inji-conformance validate and are listed in conformance/schema/README.md.

track.description: gate: the 1.0 Final plans the benchmark gates on. haip: the HAIP certification plans, run as a readiness track that never changes the exit code.

gating.description: false when this file must not change the exit code (the haip track).

version.description: Suite version as reported by the suite, for example 5.3.1.

name.description: Suite test plan name, for example oid4vp-1final-verifier-test-plan.

id.description: Plan id the suite assigned; null when the plan was never created.

config_file.description: Rendered suite configuration, relative to the run folder. Never committed: it holds private keys.

export.description: Plan export zip, relative to the run folder.

summary.description: Counts of modules per verdict. total equals the number of modules, and the five verdict counts add up to total.

exit_code.description: 0 passed, 1 gate failed (regression or stale benchmark entry), 2 usage or configuration error, 3 environment not ready (a service did not answer or stopped answering, or no module results were collected), 4 whole-run timeout.

allow_stale.description: true when the run used --allow-stale: stale benchmark entries warn instead of failing.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the run, for people.

run_id.description: UTC start time plus a suffix, for example 20261004T193000Z-1a2b3c4. Sorts by time.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date and time with a time zone, for example 2026-10-04T19:30:00Z.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the run folder: forward slashes, no leading slash, no drive letter, no '..'.

variant.description: Variant selections as the suite reports them (name to value).

verdict.description: Harness verdict (README, verdict table): conforms, known_gap (every problem is listed in the benchmark), regression (gate fails), not_applicable (expected skip), stale_benchmark (a listed problem did not happen; gate fails unless --allow-stale).

test_id.description: Suite test id; null when the module never started.

description.description: The suite's summary of the module, shown in reports and TestNG rows.

status.description: Last suite status. NOT_STARTED is the harness's own value for a module of the plan that never started.

result.description: Suite result; null while the module has none (not finished).

verdict_reason.description: One line on why the verdict was given; required for regression and stale_benchmark. Used as the TestNG failure message.

failures.description: Every FAILURE and WARNING log entry of the module.

benchmark.description: Benchmark entries that apply to this module, copied from the benchmark files, with whether each matched.

suite_log.description: Live log page on the suite; works while the suite runs.

export.description: Extracted HTML export, relative to the run folder; works after teardown.

block.description: Title of the block the condition ran in; "" when outside any block.

expected.description: true when a benchmark entry lists this condition.

matched.description: false when the listed problem did not occur in this run (a stale entry).

review.description: Checked outcome of a module the suite ends in REVIEW: the verdict Inji Verify showed, compared with what the module expects.

evidence.description: Image uploaded to the suite as evidence, relative to the run folder; null when none was made.

handoff.description: One step the harness performed where the suite waits for a person or for the system under test.

http_status.description: Status of the HTTP call that delivered the handoff; null when no response arrived.
